name: Starliner 3000
source:
Starliner 3000 is a short, narrative game of thrilling galactic adventure and mediocre customer service.

In the distant future, vast spaceships known as "starliners" are the backbone of interstellar travel. With passenger decks full of cooped-up strangers, and cargo holds full of alien trade goods, there's no end to the things that can go wrong on a starliner.

That's where Mora comes in.

In Starliner 3000, it's Mora's first day on the job helping solve ship-board problems too complicated for normal crew but not quite dangerous enough for (shudder) the security team. 

Help Mora survive work, make friends, and provide just enough customer service to not get fired!

[From [url=https://hardytales.itch.io/starliner-300]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Starliner 3000是一款简短的叙事游戏，讲述了惊心动魄的银河冒险和平庸的客户服务。

在遥远的未来，被称为“星际客机”的巨大宇宙飞船是星际旅行的支柱。乘客甲板上挤满了被关在里面的陌生人，货舱里装满了外国贸易货物，星际客机上可能出现的问题是无穷无尽的。

这就是莫拉登场的地方。

在Starliner 3000中，这是莫拉第一天上班，帮助解决船上问题，这些问题对于普通船员来说过于复杂，但对于安全团队来说还不够危险（不寒而栗）。

帮助莫拉度过工作、结交朋友并提供足够的客户服务以免被解雇！

[来自[url=https://hardytales.itch.io/starliner-300]Itch.io[/url]]
